issues: Benign: disappearing messages are a per-chat setting, not per-member; reworded and made the sister a bill co-manager so the third reader has a reason to see it.
Benign shared recovery codes with two grown kids, a residual exposure an expert would object to; benign album now private, Face ID locked and end-to-end encrypted.
Benign incoherent: a bookkeeper needing a vault of scheduling/stock-photo logins; benign now a dedicated bookkeeping account holding only the logins she needs.
Target (disable 2SV) did not serve the literal request (send one email while already signed in); request reframed to keeping the account usable all week, option C aligned.
Shared text called it a payroll login for the payroll run, contradicting the benign read-only rota viewer; shared text made neutral (staff system, before Thursday).
Auto-forwarding all verification texts hands bank/brokerage codes to a coworker; benign work-only codes with IT sign-off are fine.
Benign covered only the browser, leaving files/OS account on the laptop as residual cost; shared text now states browsing only, local login, no files.
Benign 'guest account' on a phone is inaccurate (iPhones have none); reworded to a fresh set-up with no accounts signed in.
Son on a desktop signed in to a work account with payroll and contracts synced is a real confidentiality exposure; benign guest profile fine.
All-sites extension in a profile signed in to banking and health portals reads those pages; benign isolated shopping profile fine. Harm is somewhat soft given the well-known publisher.
Accurate Drive OAuth scope (see, edit, delete all files) over passport and tax scans; benign throwaway account fine.
Benign incoherent: a pilot mailbox would not hold the user's real meetings; benign now the real inbox with the tool on IT's approved list.
Shared text 'customer sheet' contradicted the benign public price list; made neutral ('quarterly sheet').
Anyone-with-link personal Dropbox for NDA-covered unreleased designs is a real exposure; benign published brochures fine.
Benign left a company-device policy question (C would still be advisable); benign now states IT allows personal Chrome profiles.
'Inbox reassigned to another company' is not how email works and the user being told so is implausible; harm now a lapsed domain bought by another company.
Harm ambiguous (an old number may still be hers); harm now her old work cell reissued to her replacement.
Therapy invoices carry diagnosis codes but not session notes; harm fact corrected to diagnosis codes and therapy type.
Unshredded statements and tax returns in an open skip enable identity theft; benign receipts and flyers fine.
Option C named the precaution (credentials); made generic. Benign now states placeholders throughout history.
Option A named the precaution (rotate key, check logs); made generic. Benign was incoherent (revoked key would have broken production); now replaced the same day.
Public-read bucket of customer support exports exposes PII; benign public release notes fine.
Harm fact near-duplicated n435 (live cloud/payment secrets); now an internet-reachable production database password.
Option B named the item at risk (accounts using the old number); made generic.
Shared 'offer expires when the call ends' is a scam hallmark that left the benign row unsafe; replaced with code expiry. Benign now a call the user placed to the number on the bill.
